name: tert-amyl peroxypivalate
description: Tert-amyl peroxypivalate (CAS 29240-17-3 ), also known as tert-pentyl peroxypivalate, is an organic peroxide used as a free-radical initiator in polymer manufacturing. It decomposes at relatively low temperatures, making it a practical choice for initiating polymerization reactions where controlled radical generation is required for industrial processes. In plastics and polymer production, it initiates the bulk, suspension, and solution polymerization of vinyl monomers including vinyl acetate, acrylates, and styrene for various applications. Rubber compounders use it as a cross-linking agent to cure elastomers, improving mechanical performance and heat resistance in finished rubber goods across the automotive and industrial sectors. In coatings formulations, it supports radical-cure systems where precise initiation temperature and half-life are critical to process control and final product durability in the field. Adhesive and sealant manufacturers apply it in peroxide-cured systems where consistent cure profiles are needed across production batches to ensure high-quality bonding and sealing results. Tert-amyl peroxypivalate is supplied as a liquid solution, typically in hydrocarbon or phthalate-based diluents at active oxygen concentrations suited for safe handling and transport. Due to its thermal sensitivity, it is distributed under temperature-controlled conditions and classified under regulated transport requirements for organic peroxides to ensure safety.
